description: Analytic GeoParquet conversion of the full global free-flowing river reach network from the pinned 2019 figshare v1 source. Original source fields and WKB geometries, nulls, row order, and record multiplicity are preserved. Added columns expose the producer-stream row ordinal and per-feature EPSG:4326 bounds. This release does not assess scientific validity or update the source assessment.
